Equipment
 Dewatering pump
 MV 253x2RS
 Romanergo - Romania

This document outlines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be performed annually bases as indicated by Y1 
 in the title block.

The pump are centrifugal horizontal with redial impeller 
 and spiral casing provided with feet axial suction orifice and delivery 
 orifice in an upward position

The pump is assembled to an electric asynchronous three phase 
 motor by means of a flexible coupling

The unite block pump motor is assembled on an electro - 
 welvedsteel daseplate

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Ahmad Abd-Elrady 
 Mohamed , accepted by eng. Abd-Elkarem Mosa Ahmad , approved by eng. Yosef 
 Mahmod Ali general manager of Esna power station and 
 certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC 
 quality general director & MPIS coordinator

items:
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety ID category

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc
The pump is out of service

The motor disconnected from 
 MCC & control panel

Mechanical tools (complete set of 
 manual wrench - brushes - etc))

Some special spare parts 
 (mechanical seal - ball bearing - etc)

Tighten hexagonal screws with 
 atorqe wrench
Check that the shaft can freely rotate by hand
Check the tightening of the suction and delivery flanges
Check that ball bearings are filled up with grease
Check that for the presence of foreign substances which could damage the pump
